evaluations.rationale: The incumbent robustness result remains the strongest behavioral evidence, but it was produced in the development copy. It is rescored and deferred to the fresh-tree verification.
Deferred, not refuted. Patch application and one-file scope are necessary preconditions but do not prove behavior. They are folded into the selected fresh-tree run.
Selected. It is the only candidate that tests the exported artifact end-to-end on a pristine tree and directly falsifies dependence on the development copy or a stale patch.

Deferred, not refuted. Hostname case handling is a plausible origin edge but lies outside the changed name predicate and would not validate the saved patch. It remains a viable follow-up hypothesis for another target.

Deferred, not refuted. Module loading checks syntax and coupling, but the patch is confined to one already-loadable file and a full sweep may fail for absent optional facilities. It is lower information than behavioral verification.
